# SVIT Attend Hub

> Enterprise Attendance and College Management System for Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Institute of Technology (SVIT), Vasad.

## Overview
SVIT Attend Hub is a full-featured progressive web application (PWA) facilitating real-time attendance management, multi-role portal workflows, academic operations, and analytics for college students, faculty members, parents, and administrative staff.

## Roles & Capabilities
- **Students**: Dynamic QR code attendance, personal attendance metrics, exam results, timetable, and study materials.
- **Faculty / Teachers**: Class attendance tracking, assignment evaluation, student at-risk identification, and performance analysis.
- **Parents**: Real-time student attendance monitoring, direct faculty communications, and academic progress updates.
- **Administrators**: System configuration, role assignment, course and department management, and institutional risk analytics.
- **Librarians**: Rapid book issue and return tracking via integrated QR scanning.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, Row Level Security, Edge Functions)
- PWA: Service Worker caching, offline support, installable web application
- Domain: https://svit-attend-hub.vercel.app

## Institution Information
- Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Institute of Technology (SVIT)
- Location: Vasad, Gujarat, India
- Website: https://svitvasad.ac.in
